scope: 2019-01-02 through 2025-12-31 development only; stage-two bounded followup
module_isolation: EX005, EX004 and EX002 runners have distinct importlib identities; EX004 helpers retain their own bindings; new diagnostics/output belong to EX005.

control_usage.C0000: EX002 executable buyhold; no new replay or registration
control_usage.C0013: EX003 prior highest-return timing expression; selection used known development results
control_usage.C0022: EX004 65-bar breakout with daily-ATR trailing stop; retained overall comparison
control_usage.C0025: EX004 260-bar breakout with 3-ATR initial/trailing distance; direct followup control
control_usage.C0026: EX004 initial-stop-only ablation; retained reference for trailing protection

semantics.annual_return: continuous year-end equity divided by prior session equity; initial cash only in first year
semantics.rolling_return: 252 retained sessions at 21-session steps, excluding incomplete windows
semantics.excess_return: candidate minus embedded buyhold on identical continuous-account slices
semantics.holding: positive-quantity observation share, not elapsed wall-clock exposure
semantics.drawdown: slice-opening and inherited full-account peak reported separately as positive magnitudes
semantics.independence: same development pool and result-informed followup; overlapping windows are not independent
semantics.profit_protection: cost basis includes entry fee; crossing or exiting near it does not guarantee nonnegative realized return
semantics.economic_acceptance: descriptive comparison only; no automatic acceptance or stage advancement

buy_hold_path_verification.comparison: C0000 candidate versus every embedded buy_hold; exact economic paths, identity IDs excluded

Hypothetical liquidation at a close subtracts the declared exit fee only; it is not an order-fill counterfactual.

USD sums mix different position sizes and wealth paths; they are not additive strategy improvement estimates.
Open cycles are separate and do not count as realized trades or closed-profit concentration.
Trading-session and calendar-day duration includes entry and exit days; held_sessions counts days with a held completed-close observation, which can exclude an open-of-day exit.

limitations: Peak is a hindsight descriptive maximum of completed held closes, not an executable exit signal.
Initial intrabar High is excluded; no precise fill time or intrabar excursion is inferred.
Hypothetical liquidation at a close subtracts the declared exit fee only; it is not an order-fill counterfactual.
Giveback can exceed 100 percent if a positive peak becomes a loss, or be negative after an upward exit gap.
USD sums mix different position sizes and wealth paths; they are not additive strategy improvement estimates.
Open cycles are separate and do not count as realized trades or closed-profit concentration.
Trading-session and calendar-day duration includes entry and exit days; held_sessions counts days with a held completed-close observation, which can exclude an open-of-day exit.
